title: QuickSettings
description: A Simple Minecraft Mod allowing you to mark important Settings an access them trough a separate UI!
body:
QuickSettings is a simple Minecraft Mod that allows you to highlight important settings that you need to change often and access them in a different Settings UI you can open with an hotkey.

It is Compatible with Both the Vanilla Settings Menus and Modified UIs like Sodium and Reese's Sodium Options.
